svg.title: checkride: done means exit 0
svg.desc: On the left, the output of pnpm check in the course's sift repo: nine checks, types, lint, struct, dead, test, docs, links, spell, and typecheck-tests, each with a green tick and a timing, then all checks passed in 4468ms, and a badge reading exit 0, done. On the right, the red path: a test breaks, the run exits 1 and is not done, .check/summary.json names the failing slot, and you fix the root cause and run it again. On the line, checkride is the fourth hop: code becomes a gated change.

svg.text: Done means exit 0: one command runs every check, and its exit code is the verdict.
